Definition: from G1519 and G2064; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).
BiblicalUsage: To enter is the word of the door, and Jesus uses it for the kingdom itself. No one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and of the Spirit, and Jesus says He is the door, and whoever enters by Him will be saved and go in and out and find pasture. Paul says sin entered the world by one man and death by sin, and Revelation promises that those who do His commandments may enter through the gates into the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus is the door, and there is no other way in, because He said so plainly and His own death opened it. My position is that the gate is narrow and the door is one, and I am glad I found it.
